methods.label: Definition and counterexamples
methods.explanation: A regular polygon must have all sides equal and all angles equal; both conditions are necessary (a rhombus has all sides equal and a rectangle has all angles equal, but neither is necessarily a regular polygon). From one vertex, \(n-3\) diagonals can be drawn.
methods.levelReason: Uses the grade 8 regular-polygon definition and diagonal count, with elementary counterexamples.
